name: Vail
names_note: From the 2026-27 trail map: OpenStreetMap's 'Slalom Alley' beside the Golden Peak T-bar is the map's GS Alley; 'Chopstix' from the Orient Express top into Poppyfields is Gillett's Dream; the lower part of Lodgepole below the Avanti lift is Lodgepole Gulch; the top of Headwall along the ridge is Headwall Ridge (split by eye, within about 150 m).
